provenance: Compiled 3 November 2026 for release 0.1.0-candidate from the dated prior-art record (PRIOR_ART.md, 3 November 2026), the internal review searches (REVIEW_SUMMARY.md) and the reference retrieval. contributionMap.claim: Upper bound: for closed convex sets in R^d containing a common ball of radius delta, with the start within R of its centre, the distance to the intersection after N cycles never exceeds the Luner-Grimmer formula (Theorem 1), proving their Conjecture 6.2 in every dimension.

limitationTriage.limitation: Priority holds only within a bounded search.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Has the upper bound been proved elsewhere?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Dated search of 3 November 2026 across arXiv, Crossref, Semantic Scholar citing works, web and GitHub (PRIOR_ART.md); no author enquiry.
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: Exhaustive search and author enquiry are outside this release; disclosed in the paper and README.
limitationTriage.whyNotClosedNow: Requires contact with the conjecture authors and specialist databases.

limitationTriage.limitation: No human peer review and no formal verification.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Would a specialist or a proof assistant confirm Lemmas 2-4 and Theorems 7-8?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Five internal AI reviewer roles, a second-model adversarial review and audit, a proof audit and a re-review found no correctness issue.
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: External review and formalisation are outside the publication workflow.

limitationTriage.limitation: Three or more sets, relaxed projections, balls with different centres and smooth or strongly convex classes remain open.
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: For three or more sets the key inequality (7) fails (stated in Section 9).
limitationTriage.whyNotClosedNow: Beyond the scope of this release.

limitationTriage.limitation: Check scripts relied on assert and passed silently under python -O (review objection).
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Do all checks fail on planted errors in both modes?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: All checks made explicit; planted errors fail every suite under both modes; replayed with and without -O.
